title: lake1 — RTX PRO 5000 + Strata
description: RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell, Strata (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) and host telemetry for lake1. airouter alias `big`, ../claude-local.

panels.title: VRAM USED
panels.description: RTX PRO 5000 has 48 GB. llama-server with 2x131k slots measures ~46.3 GB.

panels.title: GPU / MEMORY-CONTROLLER UTILIZATION
panels.description: Memory-controller utilization near 100% with GPU below it means bandwidth-bound decode — the expected shape for batch-1 LLM inference.

panels.title: THROTTLE REASONS
panels.description: 1 = actively throttling. Sustained sw power cap means the card is at its limit.

panels.title: Strata — Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S (strata-qwen) or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 2.25 bpw (strata-deepseek), 256k ctx
DECODE TOK/S (LAST)
panels.description: Output speed of the most recent request(s), held for up to 1 h. ~30 tok/s chat, ~40 tok/s code; flat from 5k to 237k context (2026-11-06).

panels.title: TTFT (LAST)
panels.description: Time to first token of the most recent request(s): prompt-reading time per request. Measured: 4.1 s + 0.57 s per 1k new prompt tokens; reused tokens are almost free.

panels.title: PREFILL TOK/S (LAST)
panels.description: Newly read prompt tokens per second of prompt time, most recent request(s). Small turns read lower because of the ~4 s fixed cost; ~1,750 tok/s marginal.

panels.title: PREFIX CACHE HIT RATE
panels.description: Reused / (reused + newly read) prompt tokens since the server started. Agent loops should sit above 90%.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total{host="lake1"}) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total{host="lake1"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total{host="lake1"}) or vector(0)), 1))

panels.title: MODEL LOADED
panels.description: 1 = the model is loaded and answering. 0 / no data: both Strata units are stopped (lake1-gpu media) or one is still loading (Qwen ~30 s, DeepSeek ~95 s).

panels.title: REQUESTS
panels.description: Requests answered in the selected time range.

panels.title: WAITING
panels.description: Requests waiting for a free slot. Qwen (DFlash2 drafting) answers one at a time; DeepSeek runs --parallel 3. Non-zero means requests are queueing.

panels.title: SPEED
panels.description: Counter-derived. Decode (right axis: DeepSeek ~10-40, Qwen ~120-270 tok/s) would sit flat at the bottom of the prefill scale (~1-4k tok/s). The llamacpp:*_tokens_seconds gauges read 0 whenever the server is idle.

panels.title: PROMPT TOKENS: REUSED vs READ
panels.description: Wall-clock rates. Reused tokens come from the engine's conversation cache and cost almost nothing; only the read tokens pay prefill time.

panels.title: TTFT PER REQUEST
panels.description: Per request, averaged over 1 min windows: prompt time (= time to first token) and decode time. Gaps are idle periods.

panels.title: STRATA RAM
panels.description: System RAM held by the running Strata unit (strata-qwen or strata-deepseek), by kind: the experts in RAM (~108 GB for DeepSeek, ~52 GB for Qwen, which also keeps ~38 GB of them on the GPU), pinned buffers for GPU copies and the off-GPU context, and page cache of the model files (the kernel reclaims that first). Compare with all used RAM: lab VMs and Docker labs need ~93 GB, more than is left while DeepSeek is loaded, so its experts would then be read from the SSD. Needs strata-memory.service on lake1.

panels.title: TOOL CALLS / DRAFTER
panels.description: Tool calls the server had to repair or could not parse from the model's DSML output. DSpark (drafter) is auto and stays off on lake1 (tune: forced on is slower), so acceptance reads 0.
